text: The prototypes of these war machines can be traced back to the exploration boom of the Golden Age, but as swarms of engineers and miners were overwhelmed by the Greenskin tide, they too were buried deep beneath the rubble—until recent excavations brought them back into the light. Now, the survivors of that ancient calamity have mounted these refurbished, mass-produced machines, ready to settle the score with the greenskins and ratkin scum alike.
Ten Thousand Miles of Mist and Cloud

[Mirror Bloom] and [Shadowdance] are inseparable companions of the Great Moon Luan. Legend holds they are a part of the Moon Empress's power; upon hearing the cry of these two birds, the Black Jade Crow Warden can commune with the Wind of Yin and transform into the divine bird Yue Zhuo.
